caption: Firewall Rule
description: The Firewall Rule object describes a firewall rule, including its identity, configuration, and match context.
name: firewall_rule

condition.description: The rule trigger condition for the rule. For example: SQL_INJECTION.

desc.description: The description of the firewall rule.

duration.description: The rule response time duration, usually used for challenge completion time.

name.description: The name of the firewall rule.

uid.description: The unique identifier of the firewall rule.
